name: Exp_CMO_Duplex
summary: This EA trades based on the CMO (Chande Momentum Oscillator) in a duplex configuration, using two CMO indicators with different periods to generate buy and sell signals. It enters long positions when the fast CMO crosses above the slow CMO or when the CMO crosses above a threshold, and enters short positions on the reverse conditions. The strategy is a momentum-based systematic trading system with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CMO（钱德动量振荡器）的双周期配置进行交易，使用两个不同周期的CMO指标生成买卖信号。当快速CMO上穿慢速CMO或CMO上穿阈值时做多，反向下穿时做空。该策略是一个基于动量的系统化交易系统，具有可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于钱德动量振荡器（CMO）的双周期交叉系统。入场条件方面，做多信号通常在快速CMO上穿慢速CMO或CMO从超卖区上穿零线/阈值时触发，做空信号则在快速CMO下穿慢速CMO或从超买区下穿时触发。出场条件通过可配置的止损和止盈参数实现，也可能在反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA提供了固定手数交易模式，允许用户通过参数设置每笔交易的手数。资金管理方面，该EA没有内置的动态资金管理机制（如基于账户余额的比例仓位），依赖用户手动设定合理的仓位大小。双周期CMO的设计意图是过滤假信号，利用快慢周期的差异来确认动量方向，从而提高信号的可靠性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is based on a dual-period crossover system using the Chande Momentum Oscillator (CMO). For entry conditions, buy signals are typically triggered when the fast CMO crosses above the slow CMO or when CMO crosses above a zero line/threshold from oversold territory, while sell signals are triggered on the reverse crossings. Exit conditions are implemented through configurable stop loss and take profit parameters, and positions may also be closed when opposing signals appear. Position sizing is handled through a fixed lot mode, allowing users to set the trade volume via input parameters. In terms of money management, the EA lacks built-in dynamic money management mechanisms such as proportional position sizing based on account equity, relying instead on the user to manually set reasonable position sizes. The dual-period CMO design aims to filter out false signals by leveraging the difference between fast and slow periods to confirm momentum direction, thereby improving signal reliability.
pros: 双周期CMO交叉设计能有效过滤单周期的假信号，提高入场质量
CMO振荡器对价格动量变化敏感，能较好地捕捉趋势转折点
策略逻辑清晰简洁，参数可配置性强，便于用户调整和优化
pros_en: The dual-period CMO crossover design effectively filters false signals from a single period, improving entry quality
The CMO oscillator is sensitive to price momentum changes and captures trend reversals well
The strategy logic is clear and concise with highly configurable parameters, making it easy for users to adjust and optimize
cons: 缺乏动态资金管理机制，固定手数模式在不同账户规模下风险控制能力不足
止损止盈默认值为0，若用户未手动设置则交易无止损保护，风险极高
单一指标策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks dynamic money management; fixed lot sizing provides insufficient risk control across different account sizes
Stop loss and take profit default to 0, meaning trades have no stop loss protection if users don't manually configure them, which is extremely risky
A single-indicator strategy tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
No new bar check mechanism, which may cause repeated position openings on the same bar
improvements: 增加基于账户权益的动态仓位计算功能（如风险百分比模式），提升资金管理能力
添加新K线检测逻辑，避免同一根K线上重复开仓；增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤以减少不利条件下的交易
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity (e.g., risk percentage mode) to improve money management capability
Add new bar detection logic to prevent repeated entries on the same bar; include spread filter and trading session filter to reduce trades under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 止损止盈默认值为0，若未配置则交易完全无保护
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上多次开仓导致过度持仓
缺乏持仓检查可能导致信号反复时重复建仓放大风险
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit default to 0, leaving trades completely unprotected if not configured
No new bar check mechanism may cause multiple position openings on the same bar, leading to overexposure
Lack of position check may cause repeated position building when signals oscillate, amplifying risk

The strategy is a momentum-based systematic trading system with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit management.
